collections.name: Business Architecture
collections.heading: Making complexity visible.
collections.intro: Selected writing on business architecture, transformation, structured thinking and the visual tools that help organisations move from strategy to action.
collections.description: Selected writing by Aylwin Wan on business architecture, transformation, structured thinking, benefits mapping, clarity and organisational alignment.

articles.originalTitle: The Three Core Values Business Architects Bring: Clarity, Alignment, and Collaboration
articles.author: Aylwin Wan
articles.excerpt: What do business architects bring to transformation? Familiar examples reveal how they help people understand the whole, move towards shared goals, and work better together.
articles.imageAlt: Vaulted stone ceilings, tall columns and stained-glass windows inside Notre Dame in Paris.

collections.name: Life Architecture
collections.heading: Designing life with greater intention.
collections.intro: Selected writing on decisions, meaning, personal direction and the evolving idea that life itself can be approached with greater clarity and intention.
collections.pageTitle: Life Architecture & Life Design Writing | Aylwin Wan
collections.description: Selected writing by Aylwin Wan exploring life architecture, decision-making, meaning, personal direction and intentional life design.
collections.closing: Life Architecture is an evolving exploration rather than a finished system. These essays capture some of the questions and ideas that are shaping it.
